scope: V2 local history persistence, restoration, switching, malformed storage and storage failure
passed_groups: persist: V2 history stores title, server ID, turns and no DOM runtime objects
restore: reload reconstructs the conversation, metadata and assistant rendering
switch: New chat preserves old history and selecting a row restores without duplicates
search: title/message filtering, content snippet and explicit no-results state
rename: accessible dialog validates, trims and synchronizes sidebar/header/storage
export: selected conversation downloads a sanitized Markdown transcript with roles and language
delete: cancel is a no-op and confirmation removes the selected local record
malformed: invalid V2 history falls back to an empty usable shell
server cleanup: confirmed delete uses the server ID and preserves legacy storage
blocked: storage failure leaves the current-tab chat usable and protects legacy storage
